build_text_to_text_translation: build a TextToTextModelPipeline to translate text sequences between source and target languages
create_text_to_embedding_pipeline: create a TextToEmbeddingModelPipeline to convert input texts into a matrix of embedding vectors
run_text_to_text_predict: run TextToTextModelPipeline.predict to translate a list of strings from one language to another
run_text_to_embedding_predict: run TextToEmbeddingModelPipeline.predict to encode a list of strings into sentence embeddings
run_embedding_to_text_predict: run EmbeddingToTextModelPipeline.predict to decode embedding tensors back into target language text
